facts.fact: FAO's 2024 publication says the Gambian government's IFAD-supported ROOTS project developed a geospatial monitoring platform covering rice production, vegetable gardening, mangroves, forestry, agroforestry and infrastructure, with FAO generating project indicators starting from an updated land cover map under a new National Land Cover Reference System.

systems.owner: Government of The Gambia (ROOTS project, IFAD-supported, FAO technical support)
